jobs.employer_name: BIPS Institut f. Epidemiologie u.Präventionsforschg GmbH
jobs.description: Job announcementThe Leibniz Institute for Prevention Research and Epidemiology – BIPS GmbH invites applications for several positions (depending upon funding) to be filled asPostdoc in prevention research (m/f/d/x)Salary scale 13 TV-L, 39.2 hours/week (100% position). The positions are generally suitable for part-time employment.Starting from January 1, 2027 or later for the duration of 3 years (extension possible).In the coming years, the Leibniz Institute for Prevention Research and Epidemiology – BIPS will expand its research into the prevention of chronic, non-communicable diseases across the life course. The focus is on factors beyond individual diseases, such as lifestyle and environment, digital media, biological and social factors, as well as early detection. Existing large cohort studies based on primary data based will be used (e.g., IDEFICS/I.Family cohort study, NAKO Health Study), a birth cohort will be established and secondary data (health claims data) will be analyzed. Further, implementation and interventional research will be conducted to develop and evaluate innovative strategies for targeted prevention. The research is cross-departmental and involves all scientific departments of BIPS.In this context, we are looking for several postdoctoral researchers with expertise in at least one of the following areas:• Epidemiology with a focus on primary data• Epidemiological research based on health claims data• Implementation science• Health decision science• Project managementTasks:• Conduct and coordinate research projects• Publish and present research results• Write research reports• Co-supervise bachelor, master and PhD students• Support acquisition of external funding• Develop independent research projectsRequirements:• Master’s / PhD degree (or equivalent) in one of the areas mentioned above or related disciplines• Good command of spoken and written English• Strong interest in interdisciplinary research• Initiative, motivation, commitment, and scientific curiosityWhat we offer:The Leibniz Institute for Prevention Research and Epidemiology – BIPS offers exciting research topics, a stimulating international environment, a good infrastructure, close ties to the University of Bremen and an engaged, supportive and cooperative team. Postdocs are encouraged to strive for scientific independence and to establish their own research focus. BIPS holds the audit ‘berufundfamilie’ (work and family) certificate and actively promotes the compatibility of career and individual lifestyle through flexible working hours, mobile working options, and continuous professional development. We also offer additional support for international scholars to relocate to Germany through the Welcome Center of the U Bremen Research Alliance.Among equally qualified applicants, preference will be given to severely disabled candidates.Enquiries to: Dr. Wiebke Schäfer, phone: +49 421 218 56 887Additional information can be found on our homepage: https://www.leibniz-bips.de/en.Please send your application in English or German including a cover letter, CV and certificates quoting the reference number A26-34 and mention at least of one of the topics above by November 27, 2026 by e-mail as a single PDF file to:bewerbung@leibniz-bips.dePlease note that applications which do not comply with the required format (1 PDF document) cannot be considered.For information on salaries, please refer to the TV-L salary calculator for 2026; the position is classified under pay grade E13 of the TV-L. jobs.description: Job RequirementsDo you want to help create the future of healthcare? Our name, Siemens Healthineers, was selected to honor our people who dedicate their energy and passion to this cause. It reflects their pioneering spirit combined with our long history of engineering in the ever-evolving healthcare industry.We offer you a flexible and dynamic environment with opportunities to go beyond your comfort zone in order to grow personally and professionally. Sounds interesting?Then come and join our global SAP P58 Template & Operations team as Senior IT Consultant (f/m/d) SAP Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR).The SAP P58 RAR team is responsible for ensuring accurate revenue recognition and revenue reporting in accordance with IFRS 15 and local accounting standards (Local GAAP). As a Senior SAP P58 RAR Consultant, you will work alongside a highly skilled team of SAP RAR consultants and specialists. You will design and implement changes and projects, manage external service providers, support operational activities, and drive international country rollouts within the SAP Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR) and Optimized Contract Management (OCM) environmentChoose the best place for your work - Within the scope of this position, it is possible, in consultation with your manager, to work mobile (within Germany) up to an average volume of 60% of the respective working hours.Even more flexibility? Mobile working from abroad is possible for up to 30 days a year under certain conditions and in selected countries.Your tasks and responsibilities:* You will ensure the stable operation of SAP RAR and SAP OCM applications for business users, as well as accurate revenue reporting and timely month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closing activities.* You will represent the team in regular meetings and in the monthly SAP P58 Template & Operations Town Hall.* You will coordinate closely with SAP P58 Application and Functional Leads to advance integration topics. In addition, you will collaborate with the P58 AMS Lead on escalation management and advise the P58 Template Governance as well as business departments on new requirements, changes, and projects.* You will take ownership of the high-quality end-to-end delivery of changes and projects in the SAP RAR and SAP OCM environment, including design, configuration, and integration with additional SAP modules and systems.* You will drive SAP RAR and OCM implementations as the responsible consultant within ongoing international P58 country rollout projects.* You will manage stakeholders and projects, including planning, risk assessment, and risk mitigation.* You will ensure that external service providers deliver agreed services and monitor their performance based on defined KPIs.* You will ensure audit and compliance adherence in line with regulatory, internal, and industry-specific requirements, including IFRS 15 and ASC 606.To find out more about the specific business, have a look at https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/products-servicesYour qualifications and experience:* You have successfully completed a degree in Business Information Systems, Business Administration, Computer Science, or a comparable field. Relevant SAP certifications are an advantage.* You have many years of professional experience in the IT environment with a focus on SAP RAR and SAP OCM as well as related SAP modules.* In addition, you bring in-depth expertise in the end-to-end implementation of RAR/OCM solutions and in solution design across related modules. Experience with BRF+ is an advantage.* You also have proven experience in IT project management.* Furthermore, you have a very good understanding of financial processes and the standards IFRS 15 and ASC 606.* You have profound knowledge of IT Service Management as well as ITIL V3/V4, IT Quality, and Compliance.* In addition, you have comprehensive knowledge of the ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 standards as well as the regulatory requirements for non-product software in a global healthcare company.Your attributes and skills:* As you will work with different business units, functions, and regions, you have business-fluent English language skills, both written and spoken.* You stand out through strong analytical skills and excellent problem-solving abilities.* You bring very good communication and presentation skills as well as solid consulting expertise. You find it easy to collaborate with different stakeholders.* You possess strong change management and project management competencies. You are able to efficiently manage multiple projects and support requests in parallel.* You are committed, proactive, and passionate about contributing to the success of Siemens Healthineers.* International business travel is a welcome opportunity for you to support local key users and accompany operational SAP activities on site (approximately 5-10% travel activity).Our global team:Siemens Healthineers is a leading global medical technology company. 74,000 dedicated colleagues in over 70 countries are driven to shape the future of healthcare. An estimated 5 million patients across the globe benefit every day from our innovative technologies and services in the areas of diagnostic and therapeutic imaging, laboratory diagnostics and molecular medicine, as well as digital health and enterprise services.Our culture:Our culture embraces different perspectives, open debate, and the will to challenge convention. Change is a constant aspect of our work. We aspire to lead the change in our industry rather than just react to it. That's why we invite you to take on new challenges, test your ideas, and celebrate success.Check our Careers Site at https://careers.siemens-healthineers.com/global/enAs an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.We care about your data privacy and take compliance with GDPR as well as other data protection legislation seriously. For this reason, we ask you not to send us your CV or resume by email. We ask instead that you create a profile in our talent community where you can upload your CV. Setting up a profile lets us know you are interested in career opportunities with us and makes it easy for us to send you an alert when relevant positions become open. Click here to get started.To all recruitment agencies:Siemens Healthineers' recruitment is internally managed, with external support permitted only when a qualified supplier has established a formal contract with us. Unsolicited candidate submissions and referrals, absent a current supplier contract, do not establish consent and are ineligible for fees. We delete and destroy unsolicited information, thus, would recommend you refrain from any such practices. Your adherence to our policies is appreciated.

jobs.occupation: Offshore Shift Lead (m/f/d) for Nordlicht 79591 (Gruppen-, Teamleiter/in)
jobs.description: You want to aim high? At Vestas, you can! As the global leader in wind energy, we work every day to make the world more sustainable. With us, you will not only find meaningful work, but also many opportunities for personal and professional development. You can expect a varied job with responsibility in an environment that combines innovation and accountability. Take the next step and start your journey as an Offshore Shift Lead (m/f/d) for Nordlicht. The Vestas Service Offshore organisation is responsible for all activities in relation to the operation and maintenance of offshore windfarms in Northern and Central Europe. We currently have more than 4 GW under service contracts and we are continuously growing our pipeline and organisation.You will become part of an exciting journey taking care of one of the biggest OFS sites and the newest and biggest generation of Vestas offshore wind turbines, the V236.You will become part of the new SOV / CTV based team for the Nordlicht wind farm, consisting of 112x V-236 15 MW with a total capacity of >1,6GW, in the German North Sea. You will work in a key role of our Service team. Temporarily travel to other Offshore wind farms within Vestas for training, education and sharing experience is a vital part of the offered position.Your benefits – because your commitment counts! - Security & Perspective: Permanent employment contract with long-term prospects, plus a 14/14 rotation model for predictable assignments and genuine rest periods  - Development & Expertise: Comprehensive onboarding and regular training, including technical courses at the Vestas Academy and qualifications as an electrical specialist (DIN VDE 0105-100) if desired  - Working & Living Offshore: High-quality equipment, modern accommodation on an SOV with gym, cinema, and gaming zone, as well as full catering during your offshore shifts - Technology & Responsibility: Independent work with cutting-edge wind energy technology, innovative solutions, and space for your own ideas - Work-Life-Balance: 20 days of holiday during offshore deployment periods and 22 days of holiday during non-deployment periods - Add-On: Company bike, gym allowance, company pension plan, and the option for a sabbatical - Team & Culture: Open and respectful culture that values humanity and diversity, with a strong sense of community in an international environment Your responsibilities – here's where you can get involved!   - Lead day-to-day offshore operations directly from the Service Operation Vessel (SOV) on a 14/14 rotation schedule - Take ownership of team development through effective line management, coaching, and fostering a strong, collaborative culture - Ensure compliance and safety by reinforcing the code of conduct, promoting discipline, and driving HSE excellence through regular turbine inspections, safety walks, and audits - Facilitate technical focus meetings, team briefings, and support strategy deployment - Manage crew interface and contingency planning to ensure smooth SOV operations - Participate in toolbox talks and morning briefings, escalating HSE, performance, and operational issues when necessary - Oversee subcontractors activities onboard and ensure effective performance Your profile – what makes you a great fit! - Professional experience with electrical or mechanical systems, ideally gained in the offshore industry or a similar technical environment - You have a strong technical understanding of electrical and/or mechanical systems, ideally gained in the wind, offshore, or a similar technical industry- You have at least 5 years of professional experience in the wind energy or offshore sector- You bring at least 2 years of experience in a comparable planning, coordination, supervisory, or operational role- You communicate confidently in both English and German, verbally and in writing- You are proficient in common IT applications, ideally including SAP and Microsoft Office- You hold a valid driver's license- You are a proactive decision-maker who takes ownership and accountability for operational performance- You maintain a strong focus on safety while ensuring high quality standards- You have proven leadership experience and a track record of developing and supporting high-performing teams- You work in a structured and efficient manner, prioritize effectively, and remain calm under pressure- You are highly organized and comfortable managing multiple stakeholders in a dynamic environment- You enjoy working in an offshore environment and are comfortable with the opportunities and challenges it brings- You are willing to support operations outside regular working hours, including occasional weekend work___________________________________________________________________________________________________________Mache den nächsten Schritt und starte deine Reise als Offshore Shift Lead (m/w/d) für Nordlicht.Die Vestas Service Offshore Organisation ist verantwortlich für alle Aktivitäten rund um den Betrieb und die Wartung von Offshore-Windparks in Nord- und Mitteleuropa. Aktuell betreuen wir mehr als 4 GW im Rahmen von Serviceverträgen und bauen unser Projektportfolio sowie unsere Organisation kontinuierlich weiter aus.Du wirst Teil einer spannenden Reise und betreust einen der größten Offshore-Service-Standorte sowie die neueste und leistungsstärkste Generation von Offshore-Windenergieanlagen von Vestas, die V236.Du wirst Teil des neuen SOV-/CTV-basierten Teams für den Windpark Nordlicht, bestehend aus 112 V236‑15‑MW-Anlagen mit einer Gesamtkapazität von mehr als 1,6 GW in der deutschen Nordsee. In dieser Schlüsselrolle unseres Service-Teams sind vorübergehende Einsätze auf anderen Offshore-Windparks innerhalb von Vestas zu Schulungs-, Ausbildungs- und Erfahrungsaustauschzwecken ein wesentlicher Bestandteil der Position.Deine Vorteile – denn dein Einsatz zählt!- Sicherheit & Perspektive: Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag mit langfristiger Perspektive sowie ein 14/14-Rotationsmodell für planbare Einsätze und echte Erholungsphasen- Weiterentwicklung & Fachwissen: Umfassendes Onboarding und regelmäßige Schulungen, einschließlich technischer Trainings an der Vestas Academy sowie auf Wunsch Qualifizierungen zur Elektrofachkraft nach DIN VDE 0105‑100- Arbeiten & Leben Offshore: Hochwertige Ausrüstung, moderne Unterbringung auf einem Service Operation Vessel (SOV) mit Fitnessraum, Kino und Gaming-Bereich sowie vollständige Verpflegung während deiner Offshore-Einsätze- Technologie & Verantwortung: Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten mit modernster Windenergietechnologie, innovativen Lösungen und Raum für eigene Ideen- Work-Life-Balance: 20 Urlaubstage während Offshore-Einsatzzeiträumen und 22 Urlaubstage während einsatzfreier Zeiträume- Zusatzleistungen: Dienstrad, Fitnesszuschuss, betriebliche Altersvorsorge sowie die Möglichkeit eines Sabbaticals- Team & Kultur: Offene und respektvolle Unternehmenskultur, die Menschlichkeit und Vielfalt wertschätzt, mit starkem Gemeinschaftsgefühl in einem internationalen UmfeldDeine Aufgaben – hier kannst du dich einbringen!   - Leitung der täglichen Offshore-Betriebsabläufe direkt von einem Service Operation Vessel (SOV) aus im Rahmen eines 14/14-Rotationsmodells- Verantwortung für die Weiterentwicklung des Teams durch effektive disziplinarische Führung, Coaching und die Förderung einer starken, kooperativen Teamkultur- Sicherstellen von Compliance und Sicherheit durch die Umsetzung des Verhaltenskodex, die Förderung von Disziplin und die Stärkung von HSE-Standards durch regelmäßige Anlageninspektionen, Sicherheitsbegehungen und Audits- Moderation technischer Fokusmeetings, Teambriefings sowie Unterstützung bei der Umsetzung strategischer Ziele- Steuerung der Schnittstelle zur Schiffsbesatzung und Planung von Notfall- und Ausweichszenarien zur Sicherstellung reibungsloser SOV-Abläufe- Teilnahme an Toolbox Talks und morgendlichen Besprechungen sowie Eskalation von HSE-, Leistungs- und Betriebsproblemen bei Bedarf- Überwachung der Aktivitäten von Subunternehmern an Bord und Sicherstellung einer effektiven LeistungserbringungDein Profil – das macht dich zur idealen Besetzung!- Berufserfahrung im Umgang mit elektrischen oder mechanischen Systemen, idealerweise in der Offshore-Industrie oder einem vergleichbaren technischen Umfeld- Fundiertes technisches Verständnis für elektrische und/oder mechanische Systeme, idealerweise erworben in der Windenergiebranche, Offshore-Industrie oder einem vergleichbaren technischen Bereich- Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Windenergie- oder Offshore-Branche- Mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung in einer vergleichbaren Position mit Schwerpunkt Planung, Koordination, Aufsicht oder operativer Steuerung- Sichere Kommunikation in Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift- Sicherer Umgang mit gängigen IT-Anwendungen, idealerweise einschließlich SAP und Microsoft Office- Gültiger Führerschein- Proaktive und entscheidungsfreudige Persönlichkeit mit ausgeprägtem Verantwortungsbewusstsein für die operative Leistung- Starker Fokus auf Sicherheit bei gleichzeitiger Sicherstellung hoher Qualitätsstandards- Nachgewiesene Führungserfahrung sowie Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Unterstützung leistungsstarker Teams- Strukturierte und effiziente Arbeitsweise, gutes Prioritätenmanagement und die Fähigkeit, auch unter Druck ruhig zu bleiben- Hohes Organisationstalent und sicherer Umgang mit zahlreichen Stakeholdern in einem dynamischen Umfeld- Freude an der Arbeit im Offshore-Umfeld sowie Bereitschaft, die damit verbundenen Chancen und Herausforderungen anzunehmen- Bereitschaft, den Betrieb auch außerhalb der regulären Arbeitszeiten zu unterstützen, einschließlich gelegentlicher Wochenendarbeit
